name: Toma Bellbreak

anatomy.description: lean athletic adult-proportioned humanoid biped with complete bare hands and feet

design: compact older bell-trained martial artist with heavy bronze wrist bells, battered red canvas and a rooted deliberate stance; no point-click allyward kick ultimate
prompt: Clean base reference for Toma Bellbreak. Attached drawing is identity and proportions reference only. Older adult human male martial artist, broad sinewy build. Fully covered plain seamless matte gray close-fitting unitard from neck to wrists and ankles, no loose cloth. Bald, no beard. Bare hands and feet. No costume, hair, jewelry, tools, vehicles, weapons, accessories. Front orthographic full body neutral wide symmetrical A-pose, straight arms angled 45 degrees down/out, separated fingers, clear armpit gaps, straight legs slightly apart. Entire head hands feet visible with 12% transparent margin. Neutral gray sculpt, readable joints, no floor, shadow, text or halo. One adult base only.
